summary: Autodesk filed an 8-K disclosing entry into an Amended Revolving Credit Agreement and a new Term Loan Agreement to finance its pending acquisition of MaintainX Inc. The Revolver was upsized from $1.5B to $2.0B with looser borrowing conditions for up to $1.0B on the acquisition closing date. A separate $1.0B unsecured 364-day delayed draw term loan was also arranged, both with Citibank as agent. No purchase price, premium, or board recommendation are stated. The filings are financing mechanics; the key event is the acquisition announcement implied by the debt facilities. Watch for regulatory clearance and integration risk in the design/construction software space.
